subject.title: fix(diagnostics-otel): classify model calls as client spans

question: Should legacy-format model-call spans change from the implicit `INTERNAL` kind to explicit `CLIENT`, knowing existing trace-consumer filters may need updating?
rationale: The patch is mechanically narrow and externally evidenced, but exported span kind is a telemetry contract consumed by operator dashboards and alerts; this compatibility choice needs diagnostics-owner intent rather than automated repair.

options.title: Accept CLIENT classification
options.body: Merge the focused fix and treat model-provider inference as an outgoing client dependency in both semantic-convention modes.

options.title: Preserve legacy classification
options.body: Reject or revise the change if maintaining existing `INTERNAL`-based dashboards in legacy mode outweighs the improved dependency graph semantics.

recommendation.title: Accept CLIENT classification
recommendation.body: Merge the focused fix and treat model-provider inference as an outgoing client dependency in both semantic-convention modes.

likelyOwner.reason: Feature-history ownership could not be recovered from the read-only local inspection environment; the decision belongs with the diagnostics-OTel code owner.
